about:
# Forever Dice & Ale

![Forever Dice & Ale logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sudo-elmo/ForeverDiceAndAle/main/Media/logo.png)

*A round of dice, a round of ale.*

The classic five-dice game for **World of Warcraft: Forever**. Play alone while you wait for your group to fill up, or pull up a chair with your friends and see who buys the next round – in a group or with a simple lobby code.

---

## Features

- The well-known five-dice game with five dice, three rolls per turn and 13 boxes to fill
- **Solo mode** – an unfinished game is saved and continues after `/reload` or logging out
- **Multiplayer for 2 to 6 players** – with your group or with a lobby code, everyone sees every roll live, and **Play again** starts the next round right away
- Classic look: parchment score sheet, stone dice tray and the familiar dialog frame
- Click a box to see what it scores. Possible points are shown in green before you choose.
- English and German in game (follows your game language)

## How to play

Each turn you roll up to three times. Click dice to **hold** them between rolls. Then pick one free box on your score sheet. After 13 rounds the highest total wins.

| Box | Points |
|---|---|
| Ones – Sixes | Sum of the matching dice |
| Bonus | +35 if the upper total is 63 or more |
| Three of a Kind | Sum of all dice |
| Four of a Kind | Sum of all dice |
| Full House | 25 |
| Small Straight (4 in a row) | 30 |
| Large Straight (5 in a row) | 40 |
| Five of a Kind | 50 |
| Chance | Sum of all dice |

If no box fits, you have to enter a 0 somewhere.

## Multiplayer

Everyone needs the addon. There are two ways to get into a game:

**With your group**

1. One player opens **Multiplayer → Host game**.
2. Everyone in the party or raid gets an invitation popup and clicks **Join**.
3. The host clicks **Start game**.

**With a lobby code** – no group needed

1. One player opens **Multiplayer → Host game**. The lobby shows a code like `Anna-4821`.
2. The host shares the code, in chat for example.
3. The others enter it under **Multiplayer → Join with a lobby code**, or type `/dna join Anna-4821`.
4. The host clicks **Start game**.

Both ways work at the same time. Lobby codes work between players on the same realm and faction.

**During and after the game**

- You can leave the group at any time, even in the middle of a game – everybody keeps playing.
- If someone leaves the game, the others play on. Players who disconnect or `/reload` get the game back by themselves. Anyone gone for more than a minute is skipped and joins in again when they are back.
- After the game, **Play again** starts the next round with the same players – no new lobby needed. The host starts it, the others can ask for it. **Leave** takes you out of the next round.

## Settings

In **Options → AddOns → Forever Dice & Ale** (or `/diceale options`):

- **Close the window with Escape** – on by default.
- **Keep the window open when taking a flight** – on by default.
- **Dice sounds** – on by default.
- **"Your turn" sound** – multiplayer, on by default.
- **Open the window when it is my turn** – multiplayer, off by default.
- **Show invitation popup** – on by default; when off, invitations only show up in chat.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/diceale` or `/dna` | Open or close the window |
| `/diceale solo` | Start a new solo game |
| `/diceale host` | Host a multiplayer game and get a lobby code |
| `/diceale join` | Join the latest invitation |
| `/diceale join Anna-4821` | Join a lobby with its code |
| `/diceale leave` | Leave the current game or lobby |
| `/diceale options` | Open the settings |

You can also open the window from the addon compartment menu (the button next to the minimap).

## Install

1. Install it with the CurseForge app, or download the latest zip.
2. Extract it so you have `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\ForeverDiceAndAle`.
3. Restart the game.

## How multiplayer works

There is no extra server. Every lobby gets its own hidden chat channel, and all lobby and game messages go through it as small hidden addon messages – however you joined. Your party or raid only gets the invitation. The channel does not show up in your chat, and the addon leaves it when you are done.

The channel's name is made from the host's name and the PIN of the lobby code, so the code leads you straight into the right channel. A wrong code leads to an empty channel, and after half a minute you are told to check it.

Every player's addon keeps its own copy of the game and applies the same rules, so all score sheets stay the same. The active player rolls on their own computer. The others only accept moves from the player whose turn it is, and they work out the points themselves instead of trusting a number that was sent. That is fine for friendly games, but it is not built to stop someone who modifies the addon to cheat.

Every client sends a short "still here" message every 10 seconds. If a client notices it is behind, or comes back after a reload, it asks the others for the current game and gets a copy from one of them.

## Made with AI

In the spirit of transparency: this addon was built with the help of AI. The code, the texts and the logo were created together with Claude (Anthropic), guided, reviewed and tested by me. If you find a bug, please open an issue – I'll take care of it.

releases.notes:
- Lobby codes and playing without a group now work on Forever: each lobby gets its own hidden chat channel for all multiplayer messages.
- You can leave the group at any time, even mid-game.
- After `/reload` or relogging, a running game comes back by itself.
- Joining shows "Connecting to …" until the host lets you in, and tells you what to check if nobody answers.
- New "Play again" button after a multiplayer game: the same players start the next round right away, no new lobby needed.
- Fixed old player names showing in the Multiplayer window, and windows being see-through.
- Everyone needs 1.1.0.

- Multiplayer now runs only over the lobby's hidden chat channel, however you joined – with the group invitation or with the lobby code. Hidden addon whispers are no longer used, and the group only carries the invitation. So the group can be left at any time, and everybody plays the same way.
- Fixed the reason why joining with a code ended with "did not answer" in 1.0.7: on chat channels the game names the sender as "Name Realm" (with a space instead of a hyphen). The addon took that for a fake sender and threw every channel message away.
- The host's addon also recognises its lobby channel however the game client describes it (only the channel number, the name in other spelling, no sender).
- The lobby channel is now also hidden from the chat windows once the server has put you into it.
- After a `/reload` or logging in again, the addon keeps asking in the lobby channel for the running game instead of asking only once.
- Invitations disappear by themselves when the host stops repeating them (lobby closed or game started).
- If the server does not allow addon messages in chat channels, you get a clear message instead of a lobby that never fills.
- The "addon whispers do not get through" check from 1.0.6 is gone – there are no whispers any more.
- New command `/dna status`: shows what happened on the lobby channel (sent, received, thrown away). When joining fails, this line is shown by itself – please send it along when reporting a problem.
- Everyone needs 1.0.8 – it does not play together with older versions.

- Lobby codes and playing on without a group work again on servers that drop hidden addon whispers (like Forever). Every lobby now gets a hidden chat channel. Everyone in the lobby joins it automatically, and players outside the group get lobby and game messages there. The channel does not show up in your chat.
- After a `/reload` outside the group, the game comes back over that channel.
- If the server does not allow addon messages in chat channels either, the addon notices it, hides the lobby code and tells you to play in a group.
- A wrong lobby code no longer throws out other players who are joining the same lobby.
- Everyone needs 1.0.7 – it does not play together with older versions.

- Joining with a lobby code no longer shows you in the lobby before the host has let you in. Until then the lobby says "Connecting to …". If the host does not answer, you get a message that explains what to try (check the code, or join through a group).
- New: while you are in a group, the addon checks whether its hidden addon whispers get through to the other players. Lobby codes and playing on without a group need these whispers. If they do not get through, you get a message right away telling you to stay in the group, and another one if you leave it anyway.
- Fixed: after a lobby ended, its player names stayed in the Multiplayer window on top of "Join with a lobby code".
- The Multiplayer and results windows are no longer see-through, so the score sheet behind them does not shine through.
- Everyone needs 1.0.6 – it does not play together with older versions.

- New: start a multiplayer game without a group. When you host a game you get a lobby code like `Anna-4821`. Share it, and the others join under Multiplayer → "Join with a lobby code" or with `/dna join Anna-4821`. Group members still get the invitation as before, both work at the same time. Lobby codes work between players on the same realm and faction.
- Nobody has to stay in the group any more: once the lobby is open or the game is running, you can leave the group and everybody keeps playing together.
- If all five dice are held, the Roll button is disabled – there is nothing left to roll.
- Fixed a broken symbol in the tooltip of the "Show invitation popup" setting.
